description: Solar Data is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Daily solar power generation data for all the solar installation sites around the city. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The table has 12 columns. Attribution on the portal: Locus Energy. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
